articles.summary: Key Takeaways Most modern cash application tools advertise auto-match rates above 85%, but top AR teams achieve 25-35 day DSO by resolving messy exceptions faster. The performance gap between leading and average AR teams comes from handling the remaining 15-20% of problematic payments, not automating clean transactions. Workflow automation moves structured data through systems quickly, while exception-reasoning automation interprets partial payments and deduction codes without human review. Companies with clean remittance data benefit from workflow suites like HighRadius and BlackLine, which excel at processing straightforward payments at scale. The industry average DSO lingers at 40-55 days, showing that high auto-match rates alone do not solve the cash collection challenge. Exception-reasoning tools target the messy minority of payments where partial amounts, unapplied cash, and unclear invoice references create manual bottlenecks. Selecting the right AR platform depends on where teams actually spend their time, not which vendor claims the highest automated matching percentage. Quick Comparison Summary
articles.title: Why AI AR Tools Are Replacing Manual Chasing and Cash Application
